verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order (eyebrow and 20% off, then copy, product, Shop Sale CTA), but the can is a tiny, insignificant sliver, the body copy wraps awkwardly into three short lines, and the legal text under the CTA is very small. B breaks the reading order by putting the Shop Sale pill first at the far left, jammed against the canvas edge, with a minuscule 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow above it. Its legal text is squeezed into four tiny lines at the right edge, the product is shrunk to an icon, and the body line under the headline is too small to read.
